column1: # Images t's checks run in that come from elsewhere, mirrored into registry.tilo.so because
# upstream deletes the digests a pin names (quay.io rebuilds its version tags and collects the
# manifests they replace). Checks pin the mirror (`image = "<mirror>@<digest>"`); the
# mirror-images check copies each digest across, with digests preserved, while upstream still
# serves it. To move one forward: copy the new digest here and into the pins, in one commit.
